data.name: Kishorkumar
data.gender_notes: Kishorkumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kishor means 'Lord' and Kumar means 'Young' or 'Lord'. This name signifies a young lord or one who is in control of his fortune. The name Kishorkumar carries the meaning “Lord of Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kishorkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner strength and wisdom of an individual, guiding them towards prosperity and good fortune.
data.etymology: Kishorkumar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kishorkumar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kishorkumar holds a great cultural significance as it represents the divine power and the belief in the supreme control of the lord even at a young age. This name is commonly used in Hindu communities, where gods and goddesses are revered as young deities like Lord Krishna or Lord Ganesha. In Indian literature, art, and folklores, several characters and deities associated with this name have played inspiring roles in shaping the society in various ways.
data.spiritual_significance: Kishorkumar signifies a deep spiritual connection with the divine power and the belief that one's destiny is controlled by the lord. It suggests a person who understands the divine plan and is unafraid to face challenges and take risks, knowing that the lord is always with them, providing guidance and strength. The name is an embodiment of trust, devotion, and faith in Lord Vishnu and Lord Shiva, two primary Hindu deities who are believed to have the power to control the course of one's life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kishorkumar: God of Youth and Prosperity. A name symbolizing the embodiment of youthful energy and the blessings of wealth and prosperity.

historical_references.reference: Kishorkumar was a renowned Maratha poet and scholar from the 18th century. He is best known for his work 'Kishor Prabandh', a collection of poems dedicated to Lord Krishna.

Another reference to Kishorkumar is found in the 'Jivan Prakash' by the 19th-century Marathi literary figure Vishnushastri Chiplonkar. In this work, Chiplonkar praises Kishorkumar for his profound knowledge and dedication to the Hindu god Krishna.
